content: Buṭrus d řqebṭan arumani Kurniliyus
Tuɣa di Qayṣariya ijj n weryaz, isem nnes Kurniliyus, aqa-t d řqebṭan x mya, inni zi řkumpaniyyet umi qqaren ‘Aṭalyan’.
Netta tuɣa ittweqqar u itteggʷed AREBBI ak-d aytbab n taddart nnes marra, ittic aṭṭas n ṣṣdaqi i iwdan uca ikessi s řmeɛruf i AREBBI řebda.
Wa iẓra deg ijj n řewḥiy iṣfa aqa ijj n lmalak n AREBBI yudef-dd ɣares ɣar tsaɛɛet wiss tesɛa n wass, ixs ad yini ɣar tsaɛɛet wiss třata n uziř, inna as: “A Kurniliyus!”
Umi dayes inḍar tiṭṭawin nnes, iggʷed aṭṭas, inna: “Min din, a Sidi?” Inna as lmalak: “Tiẓaǧitin nnec d ṣṣdaqi nnec iwḍent ɣar řidaret zzat i wudem n AREBBI.
Ssekk řexxu iryazen ɣar Yaffa, tɛarḍed x Cimɛun, wenni umi qqaren ɛawed Buṭrus.
Xzar, netta yarzef ɣar Cimɛun, wenni iɛeddřen iřmawen, wenni ɣar iǧa taddart ɣar tma n řebḥar.”
Umi iruḥ lmalak wenni tuɣa akides issawařen, iřaɣa netta x tnayen n imsexxaren zi taddart nnes u x ijj n uɛeskari itteggʷeden AREBBI, wenni tuɣa iṭaɛ as.
Ihaja asen marra min iẓra uca issekk i-ten ɣar Yaffa.
Tiwecca nnes, am tuɣa aten deg webrid ttqarraben ɣar tendint, igeɛɛed Cimɛun x tzeqqa ɣar tsaɛɛet wiss setta, aqa-tt d ḍḍhur, ḥima ad iẓẓaǧ.
Iǧuẓ aṭṭas uca tuɣa immeẓri ad icc, uca, am tuɣa d as ssewjaden, iwyi t řewḥiy.
Iẓra ajenna yarzem uca ict n řqecɛet am yict n tcuqqet tameqqrant zi řeqṭen azdad ittwaṭṭfen zi arebɛa n tɣemmura nnes, tehwa-dd zeg ujenna ɣar temmurt.
Tuɣa dayes marra imuddaren n temmurt s arebɛa n iḍaren uřa d imuddaren nni ittbuɛen x temmurt d ijḍaḍ n ujenna.
Tusa-dd ɣares ict n tmijja, teqqar as-dd: “A Cimɛun, kkar, ɣarṣ, tecced!”
Maca Cimɛun inna: “Lla, a Sidi, war cciɣ ɛemmarṣ min iǧan d řeḥram uřa min war izdigen.”
Tmijja tessiweř ɣares ɛawed i twařa wiss tnayen, teqqar: “Min issizdeg AREBBI, war dd t tᵉttarrid ca cek d řeḥram.”
Man aya imsar třata n imuřen, uca deɣya tᵉttwassgeɛɛed tajartiřt ɛawed ɣar ujenna.

Am tuɣa Cimɛun ɛad ittxarraṣ deg ixef nnes min ixs ad yini řewḥiy i iẓra, xzar, usin-dd tnayen n yeryazen inni dd-ittwassekken zi Kurniliyus, sseqsan x taddart mani tuɣa iqqim Cimɛun. Nitni bedden-dd ɣar tewwart n řemraḥ.
Řaɣan, sseqsan: “Ma Cimɛun, umi ttkennan Buṭrus, aqa-t danita?”
Umi tuɣa Cimɛun ɛad ittxarraṣ di řewḥiy i iẓra, inna as Arruḥ: “Xzar, aqa da třata n yeryazen arezzun xak!
Kkar, tehwid-dd, ruḥ akidsen břa ma ad tcekked di ca, minzi d Necc i-ten-dd-issekken.”
Řexdenni ihwa Cimɛun ɣar yeryazen nni, inna asen: “Xzar, aqa d necc wenni xef tarezzum. Min ɣar dd-tusim da?”

Nnan as: “Kurniliyus, ijj n řqebṭan x mya d ijj n weryaz isegged itteggʷed AREBBI, wenni xef icehhed mliḥ marra řgens n Wudayen, aqa ijj n lmalak iqeddsen tuɣa iɛřem as deg ijj n řewḥiy, maḥend ad dd-issekk ɣarek, ḥima ad cek dd-aywyen ɣar taddart nnes, maḥend ad zzayek iseř ict n tebrat.”
Cimɛun issidef i-ten ɣar daxeř, igga ten d inewjiwen mani iqqim. Tiwecca nnes ikkar, iruḥ akidsen u ca n wawmaten inni iǧan zi Yaffa ruḥen akides.
Tiwecca nnes awarni as iwḍen ɣar Qayṣariya. Kurniliyus tuɣa ittraja ten am ssmunan ɣares marra aytbab n řaǧ nnes uřa d imeddukkař i-t-i-dd-yudsen aṭṭas.
Umi yudef Cimɛun, iřqa t-i-dd Kurniliyus, iwḍa as ɣar iḍaren uca isjed as.
Maca issnekkar i-t-i-dd Cimɛun, inna as: “Kkar, aqa uřa d necc d bnadem am cek!”
Am kides issawař, yudef uca yufa din aṭṭas inni dd-yusin ttmunan dinni.

Inna asen: “Kenniw tessnem aqa war iḥeǧer x weryaz d Uday ad imun ak-d ijj n ubarrani i war dd-iqqarṣen zi teqbič n řgens nnes. Maca AREBBI isscen ayi belli war icuwwar ad řaɣiɣ uřa x ijj n bnadem ixmej niɣ d řeḥram.
S uyenni usiɣ-dd ɛawed da břa ma ad cekkeɣ di ca umi xafi tɛarḍed. Maca xseɣ ad kenniw sseqsiɣ, mayemmi d ayi tejjim ad dd-aseɣ?”
Inna as Kurniliyus: “Arebɛa n wussan zeg wami tuɣa ttẓummeɣ, uca xzar, ɣar tsaɛɛet wiss tesɛa umi tuɣa ttẓaǧiɣ di taddart inu, aqa din ijj n weryaz ibedd-dd qibač inu s warruḍ d acemřař!
Inna ayi: ‘A Kurniliyus, taẓaǧit nnec tᵉttwaseř u ṣṣdaqi nnec iwḍent ɣar řidaret n AREBBI.”
Sekk ijjen ɣar Yaffa, tɛarḍed x Cimɛun wenni umi ttkennan Buṭrus. Xzar, aqa netta d anewjiw di taddart n Cimɛun, wenni iɛeddřen iřmawen, tenni ɣar tma n řebḥar. Netta ad dd-yas uca ad kidek issiweř.
S uyenni ssekkeɣ-dd ɣarek řexdenni u cek aqa teggid mliḥ umi dd-tusid da. Neccin marra i da neǧa qibač i cek, nᵉttexs ad nseř marra min zi cek yumur AREBBI.”
Abarraḥ n L’injil i řegnus d usfarreɣ n Arruḥ Iqeddsen
Yarzem Cimɛun aqemmum nnes, inna: “S tidett, ufiɣ belli AREBBI war ittegg ca s wudmawen.
Maca wenni t itteggʷeden d wenni itteggen tasegda zi kuř řgens, yusa-dd as x řxaḍar nnes.
Maɣar wa d Awař i issekk ɣar ayt n Israil d wenni zi i d asen ibarreḥ: řehna d řhudnet s Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, wenni d SIDI n marra.
Kenniw tessnem aqa Awař yiweḍ-dd ɣar marra Yahudiyya, awarni řami ibda zi Ljalil awarni i useɣḍaṣ i zi tuɣa ittbarreḥ Yuḥanna,
řexbar zi jjihet n Yasuɛ zi Nnaṣira, mammec t idhen AREBBI s Arruḥ Iqeddsen u s jjehd. Netta issara tammurt, igga řxar, issgenfa inni ittwaɣezzan zeg umɛeffan minzi AREBBI tuɣa-t akides.
Neccin d řechud xas u x marra min igga di temmurt n Yahudiyya u di Urcalim. Aqa uyřen t Wudayen x teḥnact, nɣin t.
Wa issnekkar i-t-i-dd AREBBI deg wass wiss třata uca isseḍhar i-t s bṭayṭay,
maca war iǧi i marra řgens, maca i řechud inni izwar ixḍar i-ten AREBBI, i neccin inni akides iccin iswin awarni tanukra nnes zi taddart n imettinen.
Yumur aneɣ ad nbarreḥ u ad neched i řgens, aqa d Netta d Wenni igga AREBBI d Řqaḍi x yinni iddaren u x yinni immuten.
Cehhden xas marra inabiyyen, belli kuř ijjen wenni i ɣa yamnen deg Yisem nnes, ad as ttwaɣfaren ddnub nnes.”
Am tuɣa Cimɛun issawař ɛad, ihwa-dd Arruḥ Iqeddsen x marra inni tuɣa ittesřan i wawař.
Tawmat nni ittwaxetnen, inni dd-yusin akides, tbehten, umi tamewci n Arruḥ Iqeddsen ittwafarreɣ ɛawed x yenni iǧan zi řegnus.
Minzi tuɣa ten ttesřan ssawařen s ijj n yiřes nneɣni, ssmeɣɣaran di AREBBI. Řexdenni iqqar Cimɛun:
“Ma izemmar ḥed ad iqḍeɛ aman maḥend war ttwasseɣḍiṣen ina? Maɣar, xzar, aqa qebřen Arruḥ Iqeddsen am neccin!”
Xenni yumur ad ten ssɣeḍṣen s Yisem n Siditneɣ Yasuɛ Lmasiḥ, uca nitni ttaren zzayes ad iqqim akidsen ɛad ca n wussan.
